selection_rule: blocker findings across out/r2/round1/review/*.json, sorted by (file, line), positions where index % 4 == 3 (0-indexed)

verifications.evidence: PRD-v2.md:192 states G7 (Windows shell = Git Bash, missing -> hard error) and :137 says runtimes are found by plain PATH lookup, with no exclusion rule for WSL bash.exe or the Git\cmd shim, and TECH-SPEC.md has no matching Git Bash / WSL / System32 resolution rule anywhere.

TECH-SPEC.md:175 has Pi appending instructions.md to systemPrompt in before_agent_start every call, PRD-v2.md:165 (E11) says Pi gets no injected messages at all, and ADR-0009:97 says the compaction block goes through session_compact then before_agent_start once — three different, conflicting rules for the same carrier.

The ADR-0008 scope table (lines 9-16) lists WebFetch, curl/wget, inline HTTP, build tools, Read>50KB, Grep/other Bash and user permissions.deny only; no row names ctx_execute, ctx_execute_file or ctx_batch_execute, and PRD-v2.md:191 (G6) moves the policy to an explicitly-imported policy.json.

ADR-0011:31 only edits .claude-plugin/marketplace.json on main; the repo's .agents/plugins/marketplace.json (read by the Codex CLI) still has "source":{"source":"url","url":"./"}, so a Codex marketplace add/upgrade keeps reading main's root and never follows the release ref switch.

ADR-0014:57 describes ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml only in terms of web-form widgets (dropdown, textarea, required checkboxes); the ADR has no rule for gh issue create --body-file or REST POST /issues paths, so required fields are unenforced for an AI agent filing through those paths — this is a direct gap against the owner rule that issue intake must be written for AI agents and must get maximum debug data from them.

ADR-0016:43 lists Kiro as "hint only (no rewrite, no replace) / documented gap", which lets large tool output reach a Kiro subagent uncut — this conflicts with the owner decision (ADR-0016) that large output must never enter any subagent context.

tickets/map-I3.md:22 (issue 936) requires a default server-side timeout for every host, matching PRD-v2.md's 120000 ms default; the finding's cited v1 commit removed exactly that fixed default because it killed long builds, and ADR-0008 r3 routes gradle/mvn/sbt into ctx_execute, so the same builds hit the new default again.
